description: No single first-order sentence defines the class of all infinite nonempty structures of a fixed first-order language.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Preservation.infinitude_not_sentence.{u, v} (L : FirstOrder.Language) :
  ¬∃ σ, ∀ (M : Type (max u v)) (x : L.Structure M), Nonempty M → (M ⊨ σ ↔ Infinite M)
